name: peyala-v8
description: Peyala Restaurant Operations & POS Management Suite

scripts.start: node -e "if (process.platform === 'win32' && !process.env.CI) { require('child_process').spawn('cmd.exe', ['/c', 'start-peyala-app.bat'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { require('child_process').spawn('npm', ['run', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); }"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix desktop install

author: Peyala
